accountDeletion.title: CODpromo Account Deletion
accountDeletion.intro: If you created an account in the CODpromo app, you can request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us at:
accountDeletion.p1: Please send your request from the same email address used to create your CODpromo account.
accountDeletion.p2: When we receive your request, we will delete your account and associated personal data, including your profile information, email address, saved items, and account preferences.
accountDeletion.p3: Some data may be retained only when required for legal, security, fraud prevention, payment, or compliance reasons.
accountDeletion.p4: Account deletion requests are processed within a reasonable period of time.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At CODpromo we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use and protect it, and what rights you have over it.
privacy.s1Desc: We collect the minimum data needed to operate the platform and provide its services:
s1Items: For company accounts: phone or WhatsApp number and company website
Your purchase record if you buy Premium (amount, payment method and date)
Your company ratings, code votes and favorites
An encrypted fingerprint of your IP address (we don't store the address itself) to prevent abuse of gifts and the golden key
privacy.s2Desc: You can create an account and log in with your email and password, or with your Google account (OAuth). We use an invisible, built-in bot check (no third-party service) to protect accounts from abuse.
privacy.s3Desc: We use your data only for the following purposes:
s3Items: Displaying discount codes, coupons and cashback
Letting you vote on codes and save favorites
Contacting you about your account or our services
privacy.s4Desc: All payments go through trusted third-party payment providers: Stripe, PayPal and SlickPay. Your card details are processed directly by these providers, and CODpromo never stores or sees any bank card information.
privacy.s5Desc: Your data is stored securely in a Supabase database. We only send account and purchase emails (such as email confirmation and payment confirmation) through the Resend service, and we don't send any marketing emails at the moment.
privacy.s6Desc: You have full control over your data, including the right to:
s6Items: Access and review your personal data
Request permanent deletion of your account and data
privacy.s7Desc: For any privacy question or to exercise your rights, contact us at:
privacy.s4DescApp: In the Android app, purchases are made through Google Play Billing only. Payment details are processed directly by Google, and CODpromo never stores or sees any bank card information.

cost.a: Yes, creating a company account and sending your offer are free. You can also suggest a referral link and a platform share; that's optional and agreed with you.

terms.title: Terms & refund policy
terms.intro: This page explains what Lifetime Premium means on CODpromo, how you pay for it, and when you can get a refund.
terms.s1Desc: Lifetime Premium means access to every current and future Premium code for as long as the CODpromo platform operates. You pay once, with no subscription and no automatic renewal.
terms.s2Desc: Premium codes come from partner companies, and their value can change or end at any time. We don't guarantee any specific code or company.
terms.s3Desc: The price is set when you start paying, and the price shown then is the price you pay.
terms.s3DescLaunch: The launch price is {{launch}} for the first {{seats}} members, then the price becomes {{regular}} automatically. The price shown when you start paying is the price you pay.
terms.s3DescRegular: The current price is {{regular}}, paid once. The price shown when you start paying is the price you pay.
terms.s4Desc: You can get a full refund within 7 days of purchase, as long as you haven't revealed any Premium code since buying. A refund removes Premium from your account.
s4Items: Email your refund request to {{email}} from the address on your account.
We refund you through the same payment method you used.
After 7 days, or once you've revealed any Premium code, no refund is possible.
terms.s5Desc: International card (Visa / Mastercard via Stripe), Algerian CIB / Edahabia card (via SlickPay and SATIM), PayPal, and Google Play inside the app. We never store your card details.
terms.contactDesc: For any question about Premium or to request a refund, email us at:
terms.s5DescApp: Inside the Android app, payment is made through Google Play only, under Google Play's terms. We never store your card details.

account.a: Yes. Premium is tied to your CODpromo account, so it's active on any device you sign in from.

frozen.q: What if a company has no Premium code?
frozen.a: Its card shows locked in grey in Premium mode, and its regular code stays available to you. When the company adds a Premium code, it's unlocked for you automatically.

newCodes.q: Do I pay again when new codes are added?
newCodes.a: No. Every Premium code added later is unlocked for you at no extra cost.

goldenKey.q: I have the golden key. What's the difference?
goldenKey.a: The golden key reveals the Premium code of one company you choose, once per account. Premium opens the codes of every company, today and in the future.

stork.q: I'm a Stork Community member. Do I pay?
stork.a: No need. Tap “I'm a Stork member” and enter your code to turn on Premium for 30 days.
